neighbours.label: The end piece of a few specific split rare names ('zia' in Lucrezia, 'oe' in Depoe, 'ha' in Saldanha, 'ahn' in Berghahn, 'che' in Namche). A list, not a pattern: probes of other split names (Aranha, Ushuaia, Mancha) stayed low
fire: Historians still debate the letters of Lucrezia in that court.
Whale watchers love the harbor at Depoe on the Oregon coast.
The frigate Saldanha was wrecked off the Irish coast in a gale.
Her new monograph appeared with Berghahn in the spring.
Trekkers rest for two nights at Namche before going higher.
Scholars wrote of Lucrezia and her father at length.
The wreck of the Saldanha still draws divers to Donegal.
A small motel in Depoe rents rooms to anglers.
quiet: Historians still debate the letters of Isabella in that court.
Whale watchers love the harbor at Newport on the Oregon coast.
The frigate Aranha was wrecked off the Irish coast in a gale.
Her new monograph appeared with Routledge in the spring.
Trekkers rest for two nights at Lukla before going higher.
Scholars wrote of Graziella and her father at length.
The wreck of the Lusitania still draws divers to Cork.
A small motel in Tillamook rents rooms to anglers.

short: end pieces of certain rare names
